claims.content: The Customer wants to place a bid on an auction item.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to place a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A single successful instance in which the Customer places a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer is at the point of deciding to bid on an auction item and takes the action to bid.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has placed the bid on the auction item.
in_scope_actions: Place a bid on an auction item
excluded_adjacent_actions: Finish deferred account setup after bidding
Checkout or pay for a won item

claims.content: Customer
The Customer is signed in.
The Customer's account contains the required minimum information for bidding.
The Customer has agreed to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement.
The Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button, or selects an amount and clicks the 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid' button, to place a bid on an auction item.
The Customer initiates a bid by selecting an amount and clicking the 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid' button, or by clicking the 'QuickBid Now' button to place a single bid.

The system displays a 'Bid Confirmation Pop-up' stating the bid amount, bid type, and payment method (e.g., 'You are bidding $30... using a SmartBid, on a card ending in 6744'), with 'Yes, Place [Type] Bid' and 'Cancel' buttons, asking the Customer to verify the amount and card details.
The Customer confirms the bid by clicking 'Yes, Place [Type] Bid'.
The system processes the bid and the Customer remains on the product details page.

Diverges from Step 1: instead of selecting an amount and clicking 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid' on the product details page, the Customer places a bid directly from the catalog/category list view by clicking the 'QuickBid' button associated with the item.

Diverges from Step 1: instead of selecting a bid amount from the 'Your SmartBid' or 'Your Single Bid' dropdowns, the Customer initiates the bid by clicking the 'QuickBid Now' button, which uses the value in the 'QuickBid Amount' field; the system places a single bid by adding the stated increment to the last bid.

Diverges from Step 1: instead of using the product details page, the Customer accesses bidding options via the 'SmartBid' button on the Category Page List View to place a SmartBid directly from the list.

Diverges from Main Flow Step 1: before allowing a bid to be placed, the system checks the bidder's sign-in status; if the Customer has not signed in, the system takes the Customer directly to the sign-in page and the bid is not placed in this branch.
Diverges from Main Flow Step 1: if the Customer has unresolved unpaid auction winnings more than 7 days old, the system does not allow the Customer to bid.

Diverges from Main Flow Step 1: if the Customer is subject to the escalation policy (failing to pay more than three times in a twelve-month period, unless less than 10% of total winnings), the Customer cannot bid again until a Customer Service Rep removes the account from Review Status.

Diverges from Main Flow Step 2: if the Customer clicks the 'CANCEL' button in the bid confirmation pop-up instead of clicking 'Yes, Place [Type] Bid', the Customer cancels the bid confirmation and no bid is placed.
The system processes the bid, and the Customer remains on the Product Details page of the auction item rather than being redirected to a confirmation or checkout page.
The system records the bid in the 'Item Bid History' table, displaying the bidder's Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User status.
The bid is recorded with a timestamp precise to 1/100th of a second.
The system updates the 'Current High Bid' dynamically for all items without requiring a page refresh.
If the auction item is on the Customer's My Watch List, the 'My Watch List' page displays it with the updated 'Current High Bid', 'Total Bids', 'Last Bid Time', and 'Ending Time'.

quality_flags.detail: [trigger_preconditions_coverage] The Trigger requires the Customer to be able to place a bid, but the Preconditions do not state that the auction item is still open for bidding / has not ended. Without this domain state, a closed or ended item would make the bid buttons invalid and the Trigger could not be successfully initiated. (atomic grounding: candidate was not supported)

inconsistency_hints: The Trigger includes three initiating actions: clicking 'QuickBid Now', or selecting an amount and clicking 'Place SmartBid'/'Place Single Bid'. Main Flow step 1 only continues the latter two actions. The 'QuickBid Now' path is dropped, so a Customer using that trigger has no continuation in the main flow.

The Main Flow ends with the system processing the bid while the Customer remains on the Product Details page. It does not state that the item is on the Customer's My Watch List, nor that bidding automatically adds it to My Watch List; therefore Postcondition 5's unconditional claim that the My Watch List page displays the item is not guaranteed by the Main Flow for items not already watched.

citation_audit.description: Latest model-authored candidates after internal semantic grounding verification and DRA; aligned with delivered slots.
